brief: Write an article for backend engineers on why request/response API routes are a bad fit for AI chat agents
audience: Backend engineers who are integrating LLM-based chat agents into an existing web application and trying to serve the agent's output through standard synchronous HTTP endpoints.
assumedKnowledge: How standard HTTP request/response cycles and REST APIs function
Basic LLM concepts like prompting, token generation, and context windows
The concept of server timeouts and blocking operations in web frameworks
trigger: Their newly deployed AI chat feature is throwing 504 Gateway Timeout errors, or users are complaining that the chat UI freezes for 10+ seconds while waiting for a reply.
decision: Whether to abandon synchronous HTTP endpoints for this feature and adopt an alternative architecture like Server-Sent Events, WebSockets, or background job polling.
searchTerms: ai chat taking too long to respond
how to handle long running ai requests
